request.query: send a text message through ClickSend and view my past SMS history

results.use_case: send a text message through ClickSend and view my past SMS history
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: Required Prerequisite: Retrieve aggregate usage totals and daily breakdowns using CLICKSEND_GET_STATISTICS_SMS (baseline outbound/inbound counts and spend for the period).

Required Step: Retrieve message history using CLICKSEND_SMS_HISTORY_GET (apply date range; if results exist, paginate current_page→last_page to collect all records, then filter/group by desired timezone).
Optional (if you only need outbound/sent traffic): Retrieve sent-only history using CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_HISTORY (use when inbound context is unnecessary).
Optional (if you need a complete offline dataset or very large pull): Export history using CLICKSEND_SMS_HISTORY_EXPORT_GET (prefer over many-page pulls).

Optional Next Step (if delivery/inbound troubleshooting is needed): Pull delivery receipts using CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_RECEIPTS and drill down using CLICKSEND_SMS_RECEIPTS_BY_MESSAGE_ID_GET; pull inbound messages using CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_INBOUND for reply/audit context.
known_pitfalls: [CLICKSEND_GET_STATISTICS_SMS] total.inbound may not include a price field; use .get('price') to avoid KeyError when reading totals.
[CLICKSEND_SMS_HISTORY_GET] Multi-page results are common (last_page>1); analyzing only page 1 can misattribute volume spikes.
[CLICKSEND_SMS_HISTORY_GET] Empty windows can return total=0 and last_page=0; treat as no-results and skip pagination.
[CLICKSEND_SMS_HISTORY_GET] Response nesting may be non-flat (e.g., records under data.data or data.data.data); inspect keys before iterating.
[CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_HISTORY] Sent-only endpoint; using it alone can miss inbound activity that explains statistic totals (and message bodies may include raw placeholders exactly as sent).

CLICKSEND_GET_STATISTICS_SMS.description: Tool to retrieve SMS messaging statistics for your ClickSend account. Use when you need to view usage metrics, pricing data, and date-based breakdowns of SMS message activity including outbound, inbound, and bounced messages.

CLICKSEND_SMS_HISTORY_EXPORT_GET.description: Tool to export all SMS message history to a CSV file. Downloads a complete export of your SMS history. Use when you need to download all historical SMS messages for analysis, reporting, backup, or archival purposes. Note: This exports all SMS history without filtering - use 'Get SMS History' action first if you need to filter by date, status, or other criteria before deciding to export.
